fullPassage: Have you ever brought up an idea or suggestion to someone and heard them immediately say "No, that won't work."? You may have thought, "He/she didn't even give it a chance. How do they know it won't work?" When you are right about something, you close off the possibility of another viewpoint or opportunity. Being right about something means that "it is the way it is, period." You may be correct. Your particular way of seeing it may be true with the facts. However, considering the other option or the other person's point of view can be beneficial. If you see their side, you will see something new or, at worse, learn something about how the other person looks at life. Why would you think everyone sees and experiences life the way you do? Besides how boring that would be, it would eliminate all new opportunities, ideas, invention, and creativity.

❌ ③ 글쓴이와 독자 모두: 문맥상 상대방만 가리킴
❌ ④ 삶을 경험하는 모든 사람: 뒤 문장의 everyone과 혼동한 오답
det.tip: 'How do they know ~?'의 they = 앞서 아이디어를 즉시 거절한 상대방

questions.passage: Have you ever brought up an idea or suggestion to someone and heard them immediately say "No, that won't work."? You may have thought, "He/she didn't even give it a chance. How do they know it won't work?" When you are right about something, you close off the possibility of another viewpoint or opportunity. Being right about something means that "it is the way it is, period." You may be correct. Your particular way of seeing it may be true with the facts. However, considering the other option or the other person's point of view can be beneficial. If you see their side, you will see something new or, at worse, learn something about how the other person looks at life. Why would you think everyone sees and experiences life the way you do? Besides __________, it would eliminate all new opportunities, ideas, invention, and creativity.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 how boring that would be(그것이 얼마나 지루할지)가 적절

❌ ① how hard life can be(삶이 얼마나 힘든지): 문맥과 무관
❌ ② why people often disagree(사람들이 왜 자주 다투는지): 문맥과 무관
❌ ③ when you admit mistakes(실수를 인정할 때): 문맥과 무관
✅ ④ how boring that would be(그것이 얼마나 지루할지): 모두가 똑같이 산다면 '지루할' 뿐 아니라 새 가능성도 없앤다는 흐름 ← 정답
